what: Hovering a list row crossfades the big photo beside it to that row’s photo over .8s, and releasing returns it to the first (main) photo — the big photo beside a course or menu list

options.[data-fx-part=item]: Row that raises a hand (child) — paired in order starting from the 2nd photo
options.[data-fx-part=photo]: Stacked photos (children) — first one is the main photo
options.offset: Row-photo pairing — default 1 (first photo is the lead, row i ↔ photo i+1), 0 means row i ↔ photo i (no lead, the first row’s photo shows first)
options.stay: With on, the photo of the last hovered row stays even after the pointer leaves (Brand strengths list)
options.--fx-ease: Curve (via style), default ease — Brand uses ease-in-out
options.dim: Opacity (0–1) used to dim the other rows — when given, only the row being hovered stays and the other rows fade by that amount with the same length and curve (an architecture studio’s client list uses .25). If absent, the rows stay as they are
options.zoom: Scale of the resting photo — the incoming photo shrinks to 1x from that scale as it turns on (original 1.05)
options.--fx-out-delay: Delays only the outgoing photo (via style), default 0s — the new photo covers first and the previous photo leaves from behind (Brand .175s)
options.[data-fx-part=frame]: Photo frame (child, optional) — with multiple frames, each frame counts its photo order separately and they change together on the same line (brand large photo + small photo at lower left)

note: Better to give the image box position: relative and a set size. On touch devices, tapping shows that row’s image, then goes to the link
